metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly relieve pain at the very bottom of the neck (especially around the C7-T1 area).

Each one of these exercises works a little differently. To get the best results, go through them all and use what works best for you.

As a bonus, all of the exercises can be done at home, require no equipment, and may give neck pain relief within 30 seconds.

Watch now and instantly fix pain at the base of neck!
